t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each gnome is linked to either a red or yellow basket, and the pattern is consistent. Sometimes the red basket earns more and other times the yellow earns more. The high performing basket can switch after a while, so it's a good idea to switch when needed to maximise mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: Each gnome corresponds to a different coloured basket, either red or yellow. This is consistent throughout the game, so make sure to learn which coloured gnome uses each basket. At points in the game the yellow basket gathers the most mushrooms, but this regularly switches to red and back again. When a certain colour basket starts to earn fewer mushrooms, switch to the other colour and see if you can earn more! The really high numbers come when you have the x5 multiplier so keep a close eye on what happens with the x1 multiplier.
